ItemID: NA; Title: Iv; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to choose it right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heaviness appeals to me, but I am looking for something more aggressive today.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The heavy riffs and melodic vocals fit my interest in energetic metal albums like Chuck and Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Open Door; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The darker melodic sound interests me, but it is not my first choice this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Death Magnetic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavier guitar work fits my taste, though other albums on this page interest me more right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its rhythmic intensity and unusual song structures appeal to my current interest in Tool and heavier rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After Ten Thousand Fists, I would be especially interested in another Disturbed album with forceful vocals and memorable riffs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Smile Empty Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The brooding alternative rock fits part of my listening history, but I want a heavier album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The combination of aggressive riffs and melodic passages fits my interest in In Flames and Soilwork.
ItemID: NA; Title: Let It Enfold You; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The emo-oriented sound is less appealing than the metal and hard rock I am seeking right now.
